# Supplemental Table 2
## Note: Updated to use 25 SNP threshold not 30 due to epidemiological data

```{r}
df_index$household_numeric <- gsub("H","",df_index$household) %>% as.numeric
  
s_table_6 <- df_index %>% arrange(household_numeric,visit,Species_ST_cluster) %>% select(household, visit, Species_ST_cluster, bla_genes, ESCrE_genes, ESCrE_chromosome_genes, ESCrE_plasmid_genes, plasmids,ESCrE_plasmids) %>% mutate(bla_genes = gsub(";", ", ", bla_genes),
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        plasmids = gsub(";", ", ", plasmids),
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ESCrE_genes = gsub(";",", ",ESCrE_genes),
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ESCrE_chromosome_genes = gsub(";", ", ",ESCrE_chromosome_genes),
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ESCrE_plasmid_genes = gsub(";",", ",ESCrE_plasmid_genes),
                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        ESCrE_plasmids = gsub(";",", ",ESCrE_plasmids)) %>%  `colnames<-`(c("Household",
  "Visit",
  "Strain",
  "Detected b-lactamase(s)",
  "Detected ESCrE b-lactamase(s)",
  "Chromosome-inferred ESCrE b-lactamase(s)",
  "Plasmid-inferred ESCrE b-lactamase(s)",
  "Plasmid(s)",
  "ESCrE b-lactamase-harboring plasmid(s)")) 
```

## Formatted for word

```{r}
# β-lactamase columns
bla_cols <- c("Detected b-lactamase(s)",
              "Detected ESCrE b-lactamase(s)",
              "Chromosome-inferred ESCrE b-lactamase(s)",
              "Plasmid-inferred ESCrE b-lactamase(s)")

# Build one cell: italic "bla" + subscript remainder, plain ", " between genes
bla_chunks <- function(s) {
  if (is.na(s) || str_trim(s) %in% c("", "-", "NA")) return(list(as_chunk("")))
  genes <- str_split(str_trim(s), "\\s*,\\s*")[[1]]
  out <- list()
  for (k in seq_along(genes)) {
    g <- genes[k]
    if (str_detect(g, "^bla")) {
      out <- c(out, list(as_i("bla"), as_sub(str_remove(g, "^bla"))))
    } else {
      out <- c(out, list(as_chunk(g)))
    }
    if (k < length(genes)) out <- c(out, list(as_chunk(", ")))
  }
  out
}

italic_species <- function(x) {
  x |>
    str_replace("^([A-Z][a-z]+ [a-z]+)\\b(?!\\.)", "*\\1*") |>
    str_replace("^([A-Z][a-z]+)(?= spp?\\.)", "*\\1*")
}

# Strain: italic species via markdown
ft <- s_table_6 |>
  mutate(Strain = italic_species(Strain)) |>
  flextable() |>
  colformat_md(j = "Strain")

# Gene columns: set each cell's contents directly
for (col in bla_cols) {
  for (r in seq_len(nrow(s_table_6))) {
    ft <- mk_par(ft, i = r, j = col,
                 value = as_paragraph(list_values = bla_chunks(s_table_6[[col]][r])))
  }
}

# Headers and layout: continue from the same ft
ft <- ft |>
  set_header_labels(values = setNames(str_replace_all(names(s_table_6), "b-lactamase", "\u03b2-lactamase"),
                                      names(s_table_6))) |>
  fontsize(size = 8, part = "all") |>
  set_table_properties(layout = "autofit", width = 1)

ft

save_as_docx(ft, 
             path = "./tables/s_table_6_strain_ESCrE_genes_by_index_patient.docx")
```
